summary: Accepted: the sealed 11-operation candidate exactly replays the five initial-audit repair groups. The source supports Yang Wei's AD 921 inclusive three-year cap, Yang Pu's post-Yang-Wei AD 921 installation, Xu Zhixun's AD 918 terminal activity, Li Bian's mother's direct AD 910 mourning/death context, and both duplicate Wang Yanjun hints ending AD 934.
